$comment: An overlay is a folder of your own mods that ledgr's install.sh deploys with it. This one is the repo owner's: his tab bar (my-tabs) hosts ledgr's writer instead of ledgr's host block. His pane header is the public ledgr-pane, so the chip's code exists once. A mod that imports ./ledgr/*.js gets ledgr's engine files copied into its ledgr/ folder.
